visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man with short styled hair, wearing a black face mask, a black t-shirt under a dark blue and white varsity jacket with large white lettering, and khaki pants stands in a narrow grocery store aisle. The shelves are densely packed with colorful snack bags, instant noodles, and household items. He uses his right hand to point at various products on the left shelf while looking towards the camera, which appears to be held at eye level. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail environment. (2) The man moves slightly forward in the aisle, continuing his demonstration. He gestures with both hands as he talks, his eyes showing animation above the mask. He stops to pick up a green plastic bottle of shampoo from a shelf filled with various toiletries and holds it up for the viewer to see. Behind him, the aisle continues with shelves of diverse products like detergents and packaged foods. The camera follows his movement with a slight handheld jitter, maintaining a medium shot. (3) The scene cuts to a different environment, an indoor office or studio with a white background and a whiteboard. The man is now seen from the chest up, wearing a crisp white t-shirt under a sharp black blazer. He has removed his mask, revealing a smiling, expressive face. He uses frequent, broad hand gestures to emphasize his points. A QR code and several lines of white and yellow Chinese text overlays appear on the screen periodically. The lighting is professional studio quality, soft and flattering.
